title: KidScreen: a video shelf for your kids
excerpt: KidScreen is a free, parent-curated YouTube video shelf for kids. Add only videos you approve—no search, no endless feed, and no algorithmic feed.
content_html:
I made KidScreen for my two daughters. They each have their own iPad, and I wanted them to have separate video shelves with only the YouTube videos I chose for them. Children today are surrounded by algorithmic feeds designed to keep them watching and pull them from one video to the next. KidScreen is my attempt to take some control back, because I believe choosing what my children watch is my responsibility as a parent.

It is simple: I create one family, add my children, and paste YouTube links into each child's shelf. Each child has their own login and sees only their own videos. There is no search or endless feed. A video is there because a parent added it.

YouTube has a lot of useful, interesting, and educational content that I want to share with my children. KidScreen lets me share it without handing over what comes next to an algorithm.

In my own setup, KidScreen lives on each iPad's Home Screen as a web app. I use Screen Time to block regular YouTube and other video sources. KidScreen is a web app, not a native mobile or TV app, and it does not download videos for offline use.

KidScreen is free. I built it for my family first, and if it helps other parents, I will keep developing it and keep it free. You can support the project by using KidScreen and sharing your feedback — or by buying me a coffee.

content_html_zh:
我为我的两个女儿制作了 KidScreen。 他们每个人都有自己的 iPad，我希望他们有单独的视频架，只放我为他们选择的 YouTube 视频。 如今的孩子们周围都是算法提要，这些算法提要旨在让他们持续观看并将他们从一个视频拉到下一个视频。 KidScreen 是我夺回一些控制权的尝试，因为我相信选择孩子们观看的内容是我作为父母的责任。

很简单：我创建一个家庭，添加我的孩子，然后将 YouTube 链接粘贴到每个孩子的书架中。 每个孩子都有自己的登录信息，并且只能看到自己的视频。 没有搜索或无休止的提要。 视频之所以存在，是因为家长添加了它。

YouTube 有很多有用、有趣且有教育意义的内容，我想与我的孩子们分享。 KidScreen 让我可以分享它，而无需交出算法的后续内容。

在我自己的设置中，KidScreen 作为网络应用程序存在于每台 iPad 的主屏幕上。 我使用“屏幕使用时间”来阻止常规 YouTube 和其他视频源。 KidScreen 是一个网络应用程序，而不是本机移动或电视应用程序，它不会下载视频以供离线使用。

儿童屏幕是免费的。 我首先为我的家庭构建了它，如果它对其他父母有帮助，我将继续开发它并保持免费。 您可以通过使用 KidScreen 并分享您的反馈来支持该项目，或者请我喝杯咖啡。
